mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 51 degrees and partly cloudy near Fireman's Park, with a third quarter moon visible tonight.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing the Planning and Development Department for their vital work in shaping our community. Additionally, residents may receive mail about cross connection surveys to ensure our water safety, so please keep an eye out for those letters.
We have plenty to look forward to, including live music at Bailey's Run today, the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow, and the exciting Farley Center Fall Festival on October 4.
On September 24, a vehicle and bicyclist collision occurred at Westward Drive and Jenna Drive involving an 11-year-old child; thankfully, no hospital transport was required.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
